verdict.rationale: Choosing a data region or residency is a fair question for a cloud platform, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item documents choosing where data is stored or offering residency controls. Community posts mention regions and zones only in passing (an outage in us-west1-a, a discount bought in the wrong region), which does not show a documented capability to select a data storage location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
